annotation: The participant put two hands together at waist level, slightly opened their mouth while looking at the partner.
The participant frowned then relaxed their face, relaxed both their arms while looking at the partner.
The participant scratched the right side of their head with their right hand while holding their left hand in front of their belly and looking at the partner.
The participant smiled, scratched their nose with their right hand while standing still, holding their left hand in front of their belly and looking at the partner.
The participant kept their left hand at waist level, scratched their head with their right hand while looking at the partner.
The participant grasped their right hand at waist level, nodded, opened both their eyes widely while looking at the partner.
